test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The erroneous spelling is **'Eminant'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us explore the meaning of the given options
 
 
• **Enthusiasm** - intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.
 
• **Entity** - a thing with distinct and independent existence.
 
• **Exceptional** - unusual; not typical.
 
• **Eminant** - There is no such word in English or we can say that there is a spelling mistake in the word. 
 
 
• ​If we **replace the letter a** in the word **eminant **with the **letter e**, we get the word **eminent**.
 
• **Eminent** is a proper English word and it means (of a person) famous and respected within a particular sphere.
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 4**.
